description: You are a Solar Energy Systems Engineer at SunGrid Solutions. Your company has leased a large building (currently a residential villa) to serve as the new field operations center for a 50MW solar farm. The building shell with its existing walls is open in Sweet Home 3D. Transform this residential space into a fully operational solar installation facility. The center requires distinct functional zones: a control room where technicians monitor solar array performance in real time, an equipment staging and storage area for inverters and field tools, a training room for daily crew briefings and safety meetings, a crew break room for field technicians between shifts, and staff restrooms. Create partition walls where the existing layout does not provide adequate separation between zones. Define rooms or place text labels so each functional zone is clearly identified for the construction contractor. Furnish every zone appropriately for its intended professional use. Use only Sweet Home 3D's built-in catalog. Save the file when complete.
